policy.generatedC: Existing C02 BEND_UNBOX=0 product; no source algorithms/ownership/GC policy changed by proposal.
policy.execution: Sequential one worker. Header must use thread-safe counters if policy changes.
policy.binding: Require full source hash, exact function bounds/hash, and exactly one anchor inside that function before inserting. Never global replace top: or IS_N branches.
policy.hooks: Count before nonempty branch body or after top label as explicitly indicated. Do not alter values/control flow or musttail return adjacency.
policy.boundaryMeaning: Entry snapshots, not exits. Require one parse_begin, check_begin, check_end_report_begin, report_end in order on successful single request. Record sourceSymbol to prove role. Failure/missing boundary is not completion.
policy.overhead: Counter build is diagnostic only; retain complete exact output and separate uninstrumented clocks. Disable counters with same header/build for overhead control if needed.
policy.support: BEND_PN is preserve_none calling convention, not pure attribute. Do not introduce incompatible hook calling conventions/musttail signatures.

excludedSpecializations.reason: Produces Missing without visiting a list row.

Generic List.reverse used by p143cp_canon is not attributed by book_final_reverse_rows. Thus measured book_final row passes are a lower bound on canonicalization traversal, not every reversal.

limitations: Counters observe actual generated sites, not every source-level expression after inlining/specialization. All selected named specialized variants found in this C have been classified; cloned planners are handled explicitly.
book_final_step_calls is redundant with scan_rows and is for checking instrumentation consistency, not additive work.
Separate snapshots per stage are essential: Base, checking, proof-report and backend all can use these shared helpers. Whole-process totals are not checker totals.
All canon, search and row work still executes. Counts do not indicate how much can safely disappear or allocate blame to a unique caller.
